verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing to ask of a search-API platform, but the evidence shows no Exa command-line tool. What it documents instead are SDKs (exa-py, exa-js), a hosted MCP server, agent skills installed via `npx skills add`, and a Stripe Projects command that creates an account. Each of these is a developer building block, an adjacent integration, or a host-platform feature, so none counts as an official CLI.
